title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) - Post Matric Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt of India
description: Financial assistance to students from marginalized and economically weaker backgrounds pursuing post-secondary education in recognized institutions.
verified_by: National Scholarship Division, GoI Verified Registry
financial_benefit_description: Full maintenance allowance and non-refundable fee waiver up to ₹20,000 per annum via DBT.
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority / Tehsildar
Active Bank Account Passbook seeded with Aadhaar
actionable_steps: Register on scholarships.gov.in using Aadhaar One-Time-Password. Upload verified income certificate and institute fee receipt.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Scheme empowering young women to pursue technical education (Degree or Diploma) in AICTE-approved institutions across India.
financial_benefit_description: ₹50,000 per annum for tuition fees, computer purchase, books, and competitive exam fees.
actionable_steps: Apply via National Scholarship Portal under AICTE scheme tab after taking technical college admission.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
provider: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
description: Free industry-aligned short term technical and vocational skilling with NSDC certification and placement assistance.
financial_benefit_description: 100% free course training, exam fee sponsorship, and post-placement transit stipend up to ₹15,000.
actionable_steps: Visit pmkvyofficial.org or your nearest Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK) to register for training batch.

title: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
provider: Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) / Ministry of Education
description: One-year on-the-job apprenticeship training program in leading public and private industrial establishments.
verified_by: BOAT Eastern / Western / Northern / Southern Region
financial_benefit_description: Monthly government stipend: ₹9,000/month for Graduate Apprentices, ₹8,000/month for Diploma Apprentices.
required_documents: Diploma or Degree Final Marksheet / Provisional Certificate
Bank Account details with Aadhaar seeding
actionable_steps: Enroll on nats.education.gov.in portal. Search for matching corporate establishment postings in your state.

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship (Kotak Education Foundation)
description: Financial support to meritorious girl students from low-income families pursuing professional graduation degrees.
financial_benefit_description: ₹1,50,000 per year until graduation completion to cover academic fees and hostel expenses.
required_documents: Admission letter for professional graduation (Engineering, Medicine, Law, Finance)
Income proof (Salary slip / Form 16 / Tehsildar certificate)
actionable_steps: Apply online at kotakeducation.org or Buddy4Study partner portal with required verified marksheets.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: Direct industry apprenticeship with government co-sharing of stipends across MSMEs and multinational manufacturers.
financial_benefit_description: Monthly stipend ranging from ₹7,000 to ₹12,000 with ₹1,500 direct DBT from Government of India.
actionable_steps: Register candidate profile on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and apply directly to vacancies posted by industry partners.

title: Citi India Youth Employability & Vocational Training Initiative
provider: Citi India / Citi Foundation CSR Network
description: Employability skilling, digital literacy, and job placement assistance for underprivileged youth across Tier-2 and Tier-3 industrial corridors.
verified_by: Citi India Community Development & CSR Desk
financial_benefit_description: Full scholarship covering technical skilling, soft skills coaching, and placement transit stipend.
required_documents: Income Certificate or BPL Ration Card
actionable_steps: Register at partner skilling centers or online portal under Citi Youth Employability Initiative.
